correctness.rationale: Eertree extension plus exact integer prefix-sum additive-cube detection enumerate every labeled admissible word by induction. Neither program treats a partial sample as an infinite argument.

value.rationale: The published motivating problem distinguishes additive power avoidance from abelian power avoidance for rich words. The exact additive-cube-free maximum of 104 and eight extremizers is a complete natural finite classification, a genuinely sharper and unforced boundary than the published abelian-cube-free 180. It is not a renamed old fact, arbitrary slice, or merely a code correctness result.
